title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the Goddess as the embodiment of divine power present in all beings
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the presence of the Goddess in all beings in the form of divine power. The verse offers repeated salutations to the Goddess, acknowledging the divine energy that resides in every being.
Sharing a Sanskrit Subhashitam, Shri Modi wrote on X;
“या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्ति-रूपेण संस्थिता।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः॥”
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्ति-रूपेण संस्थिता।

नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः॥ https://t.co/kx66tQ6r9v — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 15, 2026
